description: Complete minimum-order audit for the smallest irreducible Type-B tuple Pi0: an overlap-independent equality reduction followed by exhaustive order-18 edge-layer elimination.
scope_note: Covers every Type-B realization of Pi0 at full order 36. It does not enumerate naked path-union topologies because the proved degree/cycle conditions eliminate every extendable core first. It does not cover order 37 or above, any later tuple, or prove ICF. No proof-assistant formalization exists.

input.meaning: McKay's complete nonisomorphic order-18 size-27 {C4,C8}-free extremal graphs

independent_verification: The 26-edge geng stream is regenerated twice and checked once by the repository's rooted DFS and once by NetworkX simple_cycles; the graph6 streams have identical hashes. A separately compiled C detector checks the same complete geng stream and also finds zero survivors. On all 570 authoritative extremal graphs, common-neighbour and DFS C4 checks agree, DFS and NetworkX C8 checks agree, a fresh degree pass gives the recorded histogram, and the independent C checker confirms all 570 are C4/C8-free.
incomplete_attempt_not_used: An eight-shard local geng -D5 regeneration of the 27-edge extremal layer was stopped after roughly ten minutes without completed shards. It is not an input to or evidence for the conclusion.
completed_range: All connected simple order-18 size-26 C4-free graphs with minimum degree two and maximum degree three (exactly the forced 3^16,2^2 degree sequence), 101,546 graphs total; and all 570 nonisomorphic order-18 size-27 {C4,C8}-free extremal graphs from the authoritative checksummed McKay file. By E36 this covers every bridge and every required-path embedding in a Pi0 Type-B realization at full order 36.
